title: Olla-DFT v{version} — Quantum ESPRESSO toolkit
subtitle: (VASPKIT-style, for pw.x and companion tools)
items: r) New here? Recipes: complete sessions from start to finish
p) Create or open a project step by step (no commands required)
a) Deterministic guide: tell me what you want to calculate
t) Theory: the physics behind each command, explained without jargon
c) Full catalog by area, with every command option
1) Generate pw.x inputs (scf, relax, bands, DOS...)
2) Post-process: bands, DOS/PDOS and band gap
3) Calculation modules: convergence, EOS and elastic properties
4) Properties: optics, phonons, charge and work function
5) Layered materials: layers, XRD and exfoliation
catalog_instruction: Use olla-dft COMMAND --help to see all its options.

recipes.intro: Enter a key, or describe in your own words what you want to do.
recipes.not_found: I could not find a matching recipe. Try the guide (option a).

wizard.examples: For example: “whether it absorbs light”, “whether it is hard”, “what color it is”.
wizard.prompt: What do you want to know
wizard.not_found: I could not find a match. Try the recipes (option r).
